name: How long does a typical structural beam installation project take as part of a larger renovation?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical structural beam installation project take as part of a larger renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a beam installation largely depends on its complexity, size, and integration into the overall renovation. While the physical installation of the beam itself might take a few days, the entire process, including engineering, permit acquisition, and necessary preparatory and finishing work, can extend over several weeks or months as part of a comprehensive project like a whole-home remodel. AKN Design Group provides a transparent project timeline during the planning phase, ensuring homeowners have clear expectations for scheduling and progress within their customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Beam installation time varies; the physical work takes days, but the full process including engineering and permits can take weeks or months within a larger renovation. AKN Design Group provides clear project timelines.
